svg.title: Machinist — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as machinist, wearing coveralls. Visible work cue: A lathe headstock and projecting chuck hold a clearly stepped turned workpiece over the machine bed. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: a ponytail, a tapered face and round glasses.
